query:
UPDATE computer_screen_drives
            SET thaw_tried_at = now(),
                thaw_failures = CASE WHEN $2 THEN thaw_failures + 1 ELSE 0 END,
                thaw_first_failed_at = CASE WHEN $2 THEN coalesce(thaw_first_failed_at, now())
                                            ELSE NULL END
            WHERE id = $1
